headline: Yevhen Plinskyi: Trucks held hostage at customs: kilometer-long queues grow while officials do not react
summary: Cargo clearance at Ukraine's domestic customs offices has slowed significantly, with kilometre-long queues of trucks growing. The author says officials are not responding.
why: Customs delays raise freight costs and inventory risk for importers and exporters moving goods through Ukraine.
